candidate.title: TOPOLOGICAL HOCHSCHILD & CYCLOTOMIC TRACE MAPS OVER THE SPHERE SPECTRUM
candidate.claim: The cyclotomic trace trc: K_1(Z[1/6]) -> TC_1(Z[1/6]) in spectral algebraic geometry kills primitive Beal solutions via Bott-inverted motivic homotopy.
candidate.method: Topological Hochschild homology (THH), topological cyclic homology (TC), cyclotomic trace, and higher algebra over the sphere spectrum S.
obligations: Audit whether topological cyclic homology can detect discrete naive integer heights.
candidate.failure_reason: K-theory and TC of rings of integers are finitely generated abelian groups whose higher groups K_n(Z[1/6]) are finite torsion for n >= 1 (except K_0 = Z); discrete height growth and coprime integers cannot be detected by torsion homotopy groups (Failure Mode 3).
candidate.novelty_note: Analyzes cyclotomic trace and TC(Z[1/6]) over the sphere spectrum.
extracted: K_n(Z[1/6]) is finite torsion for n >= 1; topological cyclic homology computes algebraic K-theory but cannot detect coordinate heights.
